lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dha(n)n sohaaganee jin sah naal piaar ||4||23||93||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed are the happy soul-brides, who are in love with their Husband Lord. ||4||23||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕੁ ਓਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran ek ohee jin keeaa aakaar ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes, who has created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi dhiaavahu man mere sarab ko aadhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Meditate on the One, O my mind, who is the Support of all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan man mahi dhiaai ||
lines.translation: Meditate within your mind on the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod sagal siaanapaa saach sabad liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Give up all your clever mental tricks, and lovingly attune yourself to the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh kales na bhau biaapai gur ma(n)tr hiradai hoi ||
lines.translation: Suffering, agony and fear do not cling to one whose heart is filled with the GurMantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kot jatanaa kar rahe gur bin tario na koi ||2||
lines.translation: Trying millions of things, people have grown weary, but without the Guru, none have been saved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh darasan man saadhaarai paap sagale jaahi ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, the mind is comforted and all sins depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai j gur kee pairee paahi ||3||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat man vasai saach har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the True Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa jinaa man ihu bhaau ||4||24||94||
lines.translation: Very fortunate are those, O Nanak, whose minds are filled with this love. ||4||24||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)ch har dhan pooj satigur chhod sagal vikaar ||
lines.translation: Gather in the Wealth of the Lord, worship the True Guru, and give up all your corrupt ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin too(n) saaj savaariaa har simar hoi udhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord who created and adorned you, and you shall be saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man naam ek apaar ||
lines.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the One, the Unique and Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਿਦੇ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: praan man tan jinahi deeaa ride kaa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He gave you the praanaa, the breath of life, and your mind and body. He is the Support of the heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar maate viaapiaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The world is drunk, engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pau sa(n)t saranee laag charanee mitai dookh a(n)dhaar ||2||
lines.translation: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and fall at their feet; your suffering and darkness shall be removed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh daiaa kamaavai eh karanee saar ||
lines.translation: Practice truth, contentment and kindness; this is the most excellent way of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sabh hoi renaa jis dei prabh nira(n)kaar ||3||
lines.translation: One who is so blessed by the Formless Lord God renounces selfishness, and becomes the dust of all. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sagal too(n)hai pasariaa paasaar ||
lines.translation: All that is seen is You, Lord, the expansion of the expanse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam kaatiaa sagal braham beechaar ||4||25||95||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has removed my doubts; I recognize God in all. ||4||25||95||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukrit sukrit ma(n)dhe sa(n)saar sagalaanaa ||
lines.translation: The whole world is engrossed in bad deeds and good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: duhahoo(n) te rahat bhagat hai koee viralaa jaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: God's devotee is above both, but those who understand this are very rare. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur sarabe samaanaa ||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master is all-pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਣਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kahau sunau suaamee too(n) vad purakh sujaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: What should I say, and what should I hear? O my Lord and Master, You are Great, All-powerful and All-knowing. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan ma(n)dhe so sevak naahee ||
lines.translation: One who is influenced by praise and blame is not God's servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੰਧਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tat samadarasee sa(n)tahu koee kot ma(n)dhaahee ||2||
lines.translation: One who sees the essence of reality with impartial vision, O Saints, is very rare-one among millions. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan ihu keerat karalaa ||
lines.translation: People talk on and on about Him; they consider this to be praise of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kathan kahan te mukataa guramukh koee viralaa ||3||
lines.translation: But rare indeed is the Gurmukh, who is above this mere talk. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gat avigat kachh nadar na aaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is not concerned with deliverance or bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kee ren naanak daan paaiaa ||4||26||96||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||26||96||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai bharosai piaare mai laad ladaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolahi chookahi baarik too(n) har pitaa maaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: suhelaa kahan kahaavan ||
lines.translation: It is easy to speak and talk,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa bikham bhaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਆਪਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau maan taan karau teraa hau jaanau aapaa ||
lines.translation: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਸਭਹਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਬਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hee madh sabhahi te baahar bemuhataaj baapaa ||2||
lines.translation: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pitaa hau jaanau naahee teree kavan jugataa ||
lines.translation: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way?
